activities.title: My Well Window
activities.desc: Cut a circle from paper and draw what you can see through your own "well window" — then draw what is outside the circle too.

activities.title: Map the Big Wide World
activities.desc: On a large sheet, draw Gua Gua's well, the mountain, and Lao Hai's ocean. Label three places in English and Chinese.

activities.title: Count the Real Stars
activities.desc: Tonight, step outside and count stars you can see. Compare your number to Gua Gua's few stars in the well.
